scientific_role: Locate the L=24 PBC reentrant cut before freezing a production field and seed count.
paper_reference: Lajko et al., Phys. Rev. B 101, 024203 (2020), Fig. 5

field_rationale.interpretation: The finite-size wall lies below h=2.5. The pilot brackets cuts just above h_L*(0), where Fig. 5 predicts the reentrant tongue.
field_rationale.selection_rule: Choose the production h using physical observables only; topology remains blinded.

stages.role: Pointwise bond-dimension QC against the chi=64 seed-0 scan.

production_gate: Do not launch 250-300 production seeds until the physical reentrant window and chi choice are frozen from this pilot.
